proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item_or_object
proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form targets the staff itself, but activation phases cannot currently attach to an item/object target. `alter_item_kind` exists, but there is no honest way to point it at the staff.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "plant one end of the staff in earth ... to transform the staff into a healthy tree"

proposed_widenings.name: fall_on_end
proposed_widenings.justification: Reverting the tree to a staff causes creatures in it to fall. That deterministic rider is in the v4 taxonomy but is not exposed in the current surface/tracer.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff."

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.last_charge_becomes_nonmagical
proposed_widenings.justification: The last-charge rider is a permanent shutdown into a nonmagical Quarterstaff, not destruction. Current item lifecycle variants cannot represent that distinction honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff."

notes: Passive held bonuses, druid-only attunement, charge-cast spells, and dawn recharge all fit. I stopped before authoring content because Tree Form and the non-destructive last-charge rider would require omissions or false modeling.
